Dated to the sponsor's discontinuation release of 2017-06-19 (rule 6, earliest public date: it announced the excess deaths, the OS direction); the registry record (2018-12-12, tier 3) sets the status. Combination ruling: vadastuximab with azacitidine or decitabine against placebo with the same HMA, scored on the co-primaries; co-primary ruling: neither was met and the trial is called a failure. Retrodiction ruling: the model (2013) post-dates gemtuzumab's AML patient results, so retrodiction is true; it failed to reproduce them for this drug, so the status stays contra.
